about: Stage E1j staging for data/targets.json (proposal; applied by the integrator, this branch never edits targets.json). One row: T-RNG-5 gains the method and sample of its one source and the other sites' sex-class day ranges found by the E1j audit (docs/staging/e1j-prereg.md §1, §2.3). The band is NOT changed here: the only strictly lactating sample is Budongo's, and any wider band would be chosen after the model's values were seen (R quick 0.706 ± 0.080 and confirm 0.777 ± 0.050 over four realizations; B 0.595 ± 0.123 and 0.629 ± 0.027). Applying the rows changes the targets hash: protocolLog entry and new freeze by the integrator.

targets.metric: Lactating female day range relative to males

field.n: 15 adults (8 males; 6 lactating or gestating, pooled as 'lactating'; 1 receptive); 27, 13 and 3 follow-days of at least 8 h
field.method: focal follows; GPS fix every 5 min while travelling, nothing recorded inside halts of 20 min or more
field.note: ratio of class means 0.44; about 0.26-0.63 with follow-days as independent units (derived, docs/staging/e1j-prereg.md §1)

field.value: median one-day range: females 2.8 km (most anoestrous), males 4.2 (northern) and 3.8 (southern)
field.n: 61 female days (10 females), 83 and 23 male days (8 and 7 males)
field.method: nest-to-nest follows; 100 m grid lines crossed, moves under about 30 m ignored
field.note: females ÷ males 0.67-0.74 (derived); juveniles' days were credited to their mothers
as cited by wilson2021 (PMC7886264); adult females, not lactating females: 0.83 and 0.70 (derived)

accept.basis: one site (Budongo, the only strictly lactating sample); Gombe's mostly anoestrous females 0.67-0.74 and both sites of pontzerWrangham2004 (adult females, secondary) 0.70-0.83 lie above it

targets.notes: Stage E1j audit (2 October 2026): the model's observer differs from batesByrne2009's method (it sums every 5-min fix of the follow, inside halts too), but the field rule changes the ratio by -0.03 on R and 0.00 on B, inside R's own spread (0.080): no scorer change is proposed. The observer's mothers' mean rests on 13-24 complete follow-days per quick run (the field had 13); observer ÷ simulation truth ranged 0.75-1.04 for mothers across three arms against 0.83-0.85 for males, so single quick runs of this row carry about ±0.1 of sampling noise. For the integrator: either keep the band and label it 'Budongo, one site', or widen it to the cross-site range; the second choice is made after the model's values were seen.
targets.revisedPostFreeze: C8c lactation-cost taper (docs/staging/c8c-lactation-taper.md; lactation-specific model-input correction made after this row's values were seen): model revised post-freeze; scored only on the fresh C8 set B (1717-2626, step 101); counts as validation only if no parameter was set by looking at it
